speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Placenta Previa with Vaginal Bleeding. The combination of painless or mild abdominal pain with vaginal bleeding, confirmed by the transvaginal ultrasound showing placental location, is classic for this condition. Immediate bed rest and preparation for delivery are required; please avoid any pelvic exams to prevent hemorrhage.
